name: LT - Voice Agent V1 Vapi Callback + Tools

parameters.query: UPDATE voice_call_queue SET status = 'completed', updated_at = now() WHERE queue_id = nullif('{{ $json.queue_id }}', '')::uuid;
UPDATE voice_call_queue SET dnc = true, status = 'completed', updated_at = now() WHERE queue_id = nullif('{{ $json.queue_id }}', '')::uuid;

INSERT INTO voice_call_attempt (call_id, queue_id, contact_id, provider_call_id, idempotency_key, disposition, summary, follow_up_at, handoff_required, updated_at)
VALUES (
  nullif('{{ $json.call_id }}', '')::uuid,
  nullif('{{ $json.queue_id }}', '')::uuid,
  '{{ $json.contact_id }}',
  '{{ $json.call_id }}',
  '{{ $json.call_id }}:{{ $json.disposition }}',
  '{{ $json.disposition }}',
  '{{ $json.notes }}',
  {{ $json.follow_up_at ? "'" + $json.follow_up_at + "'" : "null" }},
  false,
  now()
)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET disposition = EXCLUDED.disposition, summary = EXCLUDED.summary, updated_at = now();

parameters.responseBody: ={"ok": true, "contact_id": "{{ $("Code - Normalize Tool Call").item.json.contact_id || "" }}", "queue_id": "{{ $("Code - Normalize Tool Call").item.json.queue_id || "" }}", "tool": "{{ $("Code - Normalize Tool Call").item.json.tool_name || "" }}"}

parameters.jsonBody: ={"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Time limit: 15 seconds remaining. Wrap up now and end the call by 5:00. Do not mention this time limit to the customer."}]}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO voice_call_attempt (call_id, queue_id, contact_id, provider_call_id, idempotency_key, disposition, summary, transcript_url, recording_url)
VALUES (
  nullif('{{ $json.call_id }}', '')::uuid,
  nullif('{{ $json.queue_id }}', '')::uuid,
  '{{ $json.contact_id }}',
  '{{ $json.call_id }}',
  '{{ $json.call_id }}:{{ $json.disposition }}',
  '{{ $json.disposition }}',
  '{{ $json.summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

  '{{ $json.recording_url }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
